newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Murder suspects blast out of Colombian jail.
newsitem.headline: Murder suspects blast out of Colombian jail.

text.p: Four convicts charged with murder and gun-running blasted their way out of a jail in southwestern Colombia on Wednesday, police said.
A police spokesman in Cauca province said the escapees broke out with the help of accomplices who set a dynamite charge against the wall of the municipal jail in the town of El Bordo.
Colombia's crowded prisons have been rocked by a series of attempted jailbreaks and riots this year.

In one incident, a convicted drug trafficker in Bogota's Modelo high-security jail died after triggering a bomb he was preparing for an attack on a fellow inmate, and five prison guards were killed during the year's worst prison riot in northern Cesar province.
